data.name: Jaida
data.gender_notes: Jaida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ajidah' meaning 'gentle, beautiful, radiant'. In Islamic tradition, it is mentioned in the Quran as the name of a female companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Jaida carries the meaning “Gentle, beautiful, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaida usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, beautiful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Jaida holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the constant renewal and transformation that takes place in life. It is believed that the name connects the bearer to the divine, inspiring a sense of gentleness, softness, and preciousness.
data.etymology: Jaida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, beautiful, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaida total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: جَيْدَاء

In modern times, Jaida has gained popularity as a given name in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the virtues of a pious and devout woman.
